scripts.clean:container: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'); for (const f of ['src/data/fpl_database.json','src/data/cachedLeagueData.json']) { if (fs.existsSync(f)) fs.unlinkSync(f); } fs.writeFileSync('src/data/news_ticker_table.json','[]','utf8'); const pm='src/data/pulse_matches'; if (fs.existsSync(pm)) { for (const x of fs.readdirSync(pm)) { if (x.endsWith('.json')) fs.unlinkSync(path.join(pm,x)); } } console.log('[Build] Container runtime data cleared to Cold Start.');"
scripts.build: npm run clean:container && vite build && esbuild server.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --packages=external --sourcemap --outfile=dist/server.cjs
scripts.clean: rm -rf dist server.js && npm run clean:container
